patches.value: Export N004 using coordinate bases to get finrank n and n+1 (including the empty basis at n=0), direct Mathlib full-space dimension and monotonicity, and the interval interior dimension formula. A point of E supplied by H001 gives the isometric fibre t↦(x,t), hence T≥1. The finite ENNReal bounds yield the stated NNReal representatives; casts preserve order and addition of finite values by the ordinary library identities. The chosen point does not escape. The quantified representatives are NNReal values d,k; their real coercions give d_real,k_real, and their ENNReal coercions recover D,T without any truncation.
